name: prisim-crm
description: Prisim CRM - lead management, follow-ups, calls, tasks and feedback in one dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,auth,api,web -c gray,magenta,blue,green "npm run db:start" "npm run dev:auth" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test:auth
